title: ConfirmReceiptToSlackWebhook
description: The response to setup_form_to_slack (views.open): nothing beyond whether it succeeded is read. When ok is false the call fails with Slack's error code (ratelimited is retried later). Every other field is allowed and ignored.

error.description: Slack's error code when ok is false, e.g. not_in_channel or ratelimited. A missing or empty code is reported as unknown_error. Never null.
